source_metadata.ordering: CISA KEV membership first, then descending FIRST EPSS probability, then CVE identifier; deterministic source-signal ordering only
source_metadata.interpretation: FIRST EPSS is a daily estimate of the probability of observed exploitation activity in the next 30 days. It is not impact, asset exposure, exploit confirmation, or a complete risk score. KEV and EPSS do not determine whether a specific system is affected.
source_metadata.retention: CVE identifiers are processed in memory and are not intentionally persisted or logged by this Worker. FIRST receives the submitted CVE identifiers.
